conflicts: Market cap/share count snapshots disagree: Value Research (2026-09-04) shows price $14.02, market cap stated as $2,668M, but shares outstanding of 201,945,709 at that price implies ~$2,833M (internal inconsistency on the same source page). Robinhood (2026-06-26) separately showed price $12.10 and market cap $2.25B. Morningstar (undated, apparently older/stale) shows 196.63M shares and ~$1.63B cap at ~$8/share.

Short interest readings cluster two ways: Fintel/Equibles/Benzinga all show ~27-28% of float (undated 'recent' snapshots), while several MarketBeat pages show much lower 12.60% and 11.17% readings with no clear date attached. A July 2025 MarketBeat article shows 26.84%, closer to the higher cluster. Could not resolve which lower MarketBeat figures are current vs. stale.

As of 2025-12-26, a secondary source indicated the Phase 3 REGAL trial CRO had counted 72 of the required 80 prespecified events; this predates the 6-month lookback window and could not be reconciled with the timing of the August/September 2026 disclosure-delay controversy, i.e., it is unclear whether the 80th event had actually occurred by the time of the law firm investigations.
pendingFilings: No confirmed securities class-action complaint located as of 2026-10-22 - only law-firm investigation announcements found
